title: Assistant Engineer - Roads
description:
Road Safety Audit Engineer: Responsible for supporting and undertaking independent Road Safety Audits, road safety assessments and collision analysis for highway and transport schemes. The role includes reviewing highway designs, undertaking site inspections, analysing STATS19 collision data, identifying road safety problems, preparing audit reports and developing proportionate safety recommendations. The engineer will work in accordance with DMRB GG 119 and applicable highway-authority requirements, while considering the needs of all road users, particularly pedestrians, cyclists and other vulnerable users.

* Degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in highways, transport planning, road safety or traffic engineering.
* Previous experience supporting or undertaking Road Safety Audits is desirable.
* Knowledge of UK highway standards and road safety practices.
* Progress toward an appropriate professional qualification such as ICE, CIHT or equivalent would be advantageous.
* RSA-specific competency requirements should be matched to the role and the overseeing authority rather than stated generically, because GG 119 contains dedicated requirements covering RSA team structure, audit-team approval and specialists.

  

* Quality checks of data and model outputs;
* Research and review design options for both technical and economic impact;
* Support Project Managers for on time completion of tasks assigned and to WSP’s expected standards;
* Take ownership of tasks assigned and search for solutions where required;
* Support seniors in maintaining healthy contact with different UK offices for modelling and design rask;
* Zeal to grow self and dedication towards working independently/ with minimal guidance where required;
* Ensure that Health & Safety is embedded into all work practices in line with company policies;
* Clear communication (verbal and written) with colleagues in India and the UK on all matters – project related technical communication and day-to-day matters;
* Work within project constraints; such as time, budget and resource; and
Attend and contribute in team and project meetings;

Key Competencies/ Skills

Mandatory Skills

* Strong analytical and engineering judgement
* Ability to identify safety risks from the perspective of different road users
* Attention to detail
* Clear technical writing
* Independent and objective thinking
* Effective communication with multidisciplinary design teams
* Ability to explain safety concerns and recommendations clearly
* Good understanding of the interaction between road geometry, human behaviour and collision risk
* Desired Skills
* Understanding of fundamental modelling and design techniques, traffic signals operation and CAD standards, including modelling guidelines and CD / Local authority codes and standards.
* Previous experience and capability in Junction modelling, swept path analysis, parking design, signals and junction improvement scheme
* Paper presented at / published in recognised national / internal journal(s)/ conference(s) will be highly desirable;

  

Qualifications required

* Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering;
* Masters in Transport or equivalent; and
* Good understanding of MS-Office skills.

Years of experience

* Postgraduate with to up to 2+ years’ experience.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

  

Identify and Prioritise Risk

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.  

Coordinate Remediation

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.  

Improve Security Practices

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.  

Report and Govern

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

  

Essential

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.  

Desirable

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

BGV:

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

We are seeking an experienced Professional Services Project Manager to manage resource planning, deployment coordination, and delivery operations for Palo Alto Networks Professional Services engagements across Cortex XSIAM and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) technologies. The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability and effective utilization of skilled professional services resources, coordinating project assignments, managing delivery schedules, monitoring resource capacity, and supporting end-to-end execution of customer engagements. The individual will work closely with Professional Services leadership, technical consultants, solution architects, engagement managers, resource managers, and customer stakeholders to ensure projects are appropriately staffed and delivered in line with agreed timelines, scope, quality standards, and business objectives. The ideal candidate will have experience managing consulting or cybersecurity services teams, with a strong understanding of project management, resource forecasting, delivery governance, and the operational requirements of enterprise cybersecurity implementations.

**͏**

------------------------

* Own resource planning, allocation, scheduling, and capacity management for Professional Services engagements across multiple customers and geographies.

* Coordinate the assignment of consultants, engineers, architects, and technical specialists based on project requirements, skill alignment, availability, and delivery priorities.
* Partner with resource managers, delivery leads, and technical practice leaders to forecast resource demand and identify capacity gaps, over-allocation, and potential delivery risks.
* Manage resource onboarding, project transitions, planned releases, backfills, and replacement requirements to maintain delivery continuity.
* Track resource utilization, billable capacity, bench levels, and assignment adherence; recommend corrective actions to improve workforce productivity.
* Develop resource contingency plans to address attrition, unplanned absences, project ramp-ups, and urgent customer requirements.

* Coordinate project initiation, resource readiness, delivery schedules, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans for Professional Services engagements.
* Work with engagement managers and technical leads to align staffing plans with project scope, statements of work (SOWs), customer commitments, and implementation timelines.
* Track project progress, resource commitments, milestone completion, deliverables, and dependencies across concurrent engagements.
* Facilitate project kickoff meetings, delivery reviews, resource planning discussions, and stakeholder status meetings.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, scheduling conflicts, scope changes, and resource-related risks; drive timely resolution with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure project documentation, action items, risks, issues, and decisions are maintained accurately and communicated to stakeholders.
* Support project closure, resource release, knowledge transfer, customer handover, and lessons-learned activities.
* Establish and maintain operational dashboards covering resource utilization, demand versus capacity, project staffing status, delivery milestones, schedule adherence, and open risks.
* Track project financial and operational metrics, including planned versus actual effort, billable utilization, resource costs, and potential delivery overruns.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* 7–10 years of experience in project management, Professional Services operations, resource management, technical delivery coordination, or workforce planning within IT services or cybersecurity environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing resource allocation and delivery operations for multiple concurrent technical projects.
* Strong understanding of project planning, resource forecasting, utilization management, delivery governance, risk management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Experience coordinating technical consultants, engineers, architects, and specialist delivery teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using project management, resource planning, PSA, ERP, or reporting tools.

* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, customer-focused Professional Services environment.

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.  
  
  
  
**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**

Role Summary

Defines end-to-end infrastructure architecture — compute, storage, network, and cloud — for Aon's global technology estate, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise technology strategy and standards worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop infrastructure architecture blueprints, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps
* Evaluate and select infrastructure technologies and platforms across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments
* Lead design reviews and provide architectural governance across infrastructure projects
* Define non-functional requirements: availability, disaster recovery, performance, scalability, security
* Partner with security, network, and application architects to ensure end-to-end solution integrity
* Guide migration and modernization initiatives (data center exit, cloud migration, hybrid connectivity)
* Produce architecture decision records (ADRs) and maintain architecture documentation/standards
* Mentor infrastructure engineers and provide technical leadership on complex initiatives

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field; relevant Master's a plus
* 10+ years in infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years in an architect-level role
* Certifications such as TOGAF, or AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, preferred
* Demonstrated experience architecting hybrid/multi-cloud environments at enterprise scale

Technical Skills

* Enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF or equivalent)
* Compute, storage, and network architecture across on-premises and cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Virtualization (VMware), containers/Kubernetes, disaster recovery/business continuity design
* Security architecture fundamentals (zero trust, network segmentation, IAM)
* Capacity planning and performance engineering
* Architecture documentation and diagramming (e.g., ArchiMate, Visio, Lucidchart)

Core Competencies

* Strategic and systems thinking
* Technical leadership and mentoring
* Stakeholder management across business and technology
* Strong communication of complex concepts to varied audiences
* Balancing innovation with risk and governance

### **Description and Requirements**

Roles & Responsibilities
-

* Lead the design, implementation, migration, upgrade, optimization, and operational support of Hybrid Cloud, Enterprise, Data Center, Security, Wireless, and edge network infrastructures.
* Perform network discovery, assessment, technical due diligence, solution validation, HLD/LLD Creation, implementation/migration planning, , execution, testing, and operational handover activities.
* Possess strong hands-on implementation and troubleshooting expertise across Enterprise Campus, Data Center, WAN, Security, Wireless, and Hybrid Cloud environments.
* Deploy, configure, migrate, and support Data Center networking solutions utilizing Cisco Nexus, catalyst, Arista, NVIDIA technologies.
* Implement and support traditional / Spine-Leaf Data Center architectures, including VXLAN EVPN, Layer-2 and Layer-3 fabrics, and Data Center Interconnect (DCI) solutions.
* Configure, migrate, and troubleshoot advanced Routing & Switching technologies including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN EVPN, Multicast, QoS, HSRP, VRRP, and ECMP.
* Design , Implement, migrate, and support Network Security solutions including Cisco Secure Firewall, Palo Alto NGFW, Fortinet, SASE solutions, SD-WAN, IPS/IDS, Site-to-Site VPN, and Remote Access VPN technologies.
* Implement and support Load Balancing solutions using F5 BIG-IP and Radware platforms.
* Design & implement, optimize, troubleshoot, and support Enterprise Wireless solutions using Cisco Wireless and Aruba Wireless technologies.
* Support Hybrid Cloud networking integrations, cloud connectivity, and network security requirements across public and private cloud environments.
* Lead customer migration activities, change implementation, technology refresh projects, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical Point of Contact, during implementation, migration, and post-implementation support phases.
* Serve as the Level 3 (L3)/SME Escalation Engineer for complex Network and Security incidents for customers.
* Participate as the Delivery SME and Design/Technical Owner during escalations, engaging with OEM vendors, operations teams, and customers to drive troubleshooting and service restoration.
* Collaborate with global delivery teams, project managers, operations teams, OEMs, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful service delivery.
* Develop and maintain implementation guides, migration runbooks, Method of Procedure (MOP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), validation reports, test plans, and as-built documentation.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet agreed security, performance, scalability, availability, and operational requirements.
* Mandatory travel requirement of up to 25% (Domestic and International).
* Flexible working hours are required to support global customers across multiple regions and time zones.
* Ability to support maintenance windows, migrations, major incidents, and critical customer escalations outside standard business hours when required.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations & Threat Hunter with exceptional troubleshooting abilities and a deep understanding of both endpoint and cloud threats. The ideal candidate will be a key player in our Security Operations Center (SOC), proactively hunting for threats, analyzing security incidents, and ensuring the protection of our infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments.

This role offers a distinct growth trajectory: beyond day-to-day triage and incident response, you will dedicate meaningful time to high-impact engineering projects, AI-driven security automation, and direct collaboration with senior engineering leadership.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Analyze security alerts from security tools to identify potential threats.
* Conduct forensic investigations and deep-dive analysis of security events to identify trends, attack techniques, and areas for improvement.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, and cloud environments to identify sophisticated cyber threats.
* Analyze security logs, behavioral patterns, and anomalies to detect indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Investigate security incidents, perform forensic analysis, and provide actionable recommendations for mitigation and remediation.
* Develop and refine threat hunting methodologies, leveraging frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
* Automate threat detection and analysis using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Continuously monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends to improve detection and response strategies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of experience in security operations, threat hunting, or a similar cybersecurity role.
* Experience working with log data for detection and response across Cloud, EDR, Network, and related telemetry.
* Experience developing and deploying effective detection rules (e.g., YARA, Sigma, SQL-based rules, Network signatures).
* Strong understanding of network security monitoring, packet analysis, and log correlation.
* Deep understanding of advanced threat detection methodologies and threat intelligence.
* Proficiency in analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) based on frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation for security operations (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).
* Solid understanding of endpoint security, identity management, cloud security, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat intelligence.
* Strong communication skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and collaborate across teams.

**Working Model & Schedule**
----------------------------

* **Global Exposure & Quarterly Rotations:** To foster close alignment with our distributed engineering teams and US leadership, this role follows a structured quarterly time-zone rotation (rotating through San Francisco/PST, New York/EST, and local daytime business hours). This cadence provides direct access to senior leadership, high-visibility global projects, and cross-functional teams across the organization.
* **Rotational On-Call Coverage:** Shared participation in rotational weekend on-call pager duty to triage critical incidents alongside team members and leadership.
* **Location & Hybrid Flexibility:** Based in Bangalore. During local daytime business cycles, work on-site from our Bangalore office to build strong peer relationships and cross-functional connections; flexible remote arrangements apply during global and US-aligned cycles.

Applicants located in California and/or applying to a role based in California, please refer to our Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy here.

title: Security Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 23, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752299

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**Job Summary:**

As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.

  

The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.

  

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity:**

The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.

The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.

  

A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

  

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

  

**What working at EY offers:**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a senior, hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Senior Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: Design and implement secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: Architect and integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Technical leadership: Define standards, review code and designs, mentor engineers and work closely with architects, vendors and business stakeholders.

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 7+ years (recommended) in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform – Expert level: Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Expert level: Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - Advanced: REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - Advanced: MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - Advanced: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - Advanced: IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Senior, hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: Strong background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with a strong back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Advanced Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Solid data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, data modelling, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Hands-on technical leader who still writes code and builds solutions.
* Strong architectural thinking, balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Drives large initiatives with ownership, structure and focus on outcomes.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Mentors and raises the technical level of the team.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Engineer, CAE Application
description:
**Your Job**

Molex is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer / Technical Lead** to join our Multiphysics Simulation Group in Bengaluru. In this role, you will combine deep structural FEA expertise with surrogate modeling to help transform complex simulation data into fast, reliable predictions that support product-design decisions. You will lead structural simulation programs, develop and validate surrogate models, and help advance Virtual Product Qualification through credible physics-based prediction.

**Our Team**

You will join the Multiphysics Simulation Group within Global Engineering Services and Predictive Engineering at Molex's Global Technical Center in Bengaluru. The team is advancing simulation, digital twins, and AI-assisted surrogate models to reduce prototype-heavy development cycles and enable faster engineering decisions.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead structural FEA programs involving quasi-static loading, impact and drop testing, pressure-induced deformation, vibration, fatigue, and creep.
* Develop and validate surrogate models that predict stress, strain, displacement, and deformation from FEA training data, reducing dependence on full simulation runs during design iteration.
* Apply approaches including regression, response-surface methods, design of experiments, neural networks, and Bayesian correction techniques where appropriate.
* Establish confidence in simulation and surrogate predictions through convergence studies, sensitivity analysis, error quantification, cross-validation, and correlation with physical test data.
* Define the design-space boundaries and limitations within which surrogate models can be reliably used.
* Partner with product engineering teams across Molex businesses to translate simulation insights into product-design decisions.
* Mentor engineers and strengthen structural simulation methods, review practices, and technical standards across the team.
* Contribute validated structural prediction models to broader multiphysics and digital-twin architectures, supporting progress toward Virtual Product Qualification.

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil, Computational Mechanics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated structural simulation experience with strong knowledge of solid mechanics, finite-element methods, nonlinear analysis, and contact mechanics.
* Hands-on experience with at least one commercial FEA solver such as Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Nastran, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience personally building and validating surrogate or reduced-order models from simulation data to predict structural responses.
* Programming experience using Python or MATLAB for model development or automation, with experience using regression, response-surface, Gaussian-process, or neural-network modeling approaches.

  
**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Solid Mechanics, or a related discipline.
* Experience with commercial surrogate or AI simulation platforms such as Physics AI, DEP MeshWorks, Ansys SimAI, Altair HyperStudy, Siemens HEEDS, Rescale, or Isight.
* Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, Physics-Informed Neural Networks, or physics-constrained machine learning.
* Experience with impact, drop-test, or crash simulation in high-reliability product applications.
* Understanding of digital-twin architectures and integration of surrogate models into multiphysics environments.
* Experience with coupled thermo-structural or electro-thermal-structural simulation.

  
**Who We Are**

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: BIM Technician - MEP
description:
As a BIM Technician, you will be part of WSP. You will be providing CAD/BIM expertise in developing high quality design drawings. It is expected that you demonstrate clear understanding of various tools within BIM softwares such as REVIT/BIM 360 & Navisworks.

  

* Production of high-quality 3D BIM Models in Revit.
* Perform variety of moderately-difficult to difficult 3D CAD modeling assignments under minimal supervision.
* Coordinate with Design Engineer for the information required to prepare BIM models and generate drawings as per specifications defined by our Client.
* Must have strong 3D visualization capabilities.
* Must possess a strong ability to work independently within a project team. Collaborate with other designers, engineers, architects and clients to convert information into layout designs, drawings and models using REVIT.
* Decipher information received from various formats (hand sketches, BIM Execution Plans and Architectural drawings).
* Should be interested and able to work in an international environment.
* Complete other duties as assigned appropriate for the designated grade level.

  

* Degree/Diploma in Engineering.
* Experience with Architectural / Structural/ Mechanical drawings, developing equipment layout and site plan drawings.
* Experience in leading the modeling related tasks and coordinating with client to get the deliverables completed on schedule and budget.
* Must possess a strong working knowledge of core 3D CADD applications (such as Revit, Civil 3D, Plant 3D), as outlined above.
* Must have proficient knowledge in handling Revit and other BIM application tools and concepts of BIM. Capable of producing Revit plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules etc. must be familiar with all Revit tools and creating and editing view range, drafting views, view templates, system families, materials, project/shared parameters, multi-category schedules, project title blocks, Worksets, Revit category-based profile, annotation families etc., must be capable of linking multiple Revit files and work. Capable of handling Revit projects without any guidance from the superior and managing the tasks with sharing the work with others.
* Must be capable of performing Clash detection using Navisworks and Revit interference check, export Clash reports, review clash reports etc.
  + Create Dynamic Blocks with parameters
  + Use different 3D representations such as shading, conceptual etc.
  + Export 3D geometry for use by subcontractors and outside agencies.
  + Assist in the production of 2D sheets (plans, sections, 3D clips and details) from 3D/4D multi-discipline models (Transitional 2D techniques)

title: Senior Engineer - Electrical
description:
Applicant should have 8-12 years of experience on basic and detailed engineering design of Electrical works on combined cycle projects and substation projects. Has a good knowledge of Electrical Systems and Physical design, the principles, and practices of related technical areas and of coordinating with other technical disciplines. Candidate should have exposure to IEC, US, Euro or any other foreign codes/standards and middle east local practices.

  

* Technical review of electrical equipment sizing, specifications, technical datasheets, technical bid evaluation and vendor documents reviews of various electrical equipment like GIS, Switchyard equipment, Power Transformer, Busduct, MV & LV switchgear, MCCs, power & distribution transformers, EDGs, DC systems / UPS, Cables, generator circuit breaker, bus duct, lighting fixtures etc.
* Technical review of SLDs, protection & metering diagrams, switchgear scheme drawings and logic diagrams, relay setting & protection coordination of the system, cable sizing etc.
* Review of electrical layouts like raceways, lighting, grounding & lightning protection, Switchyard layouts etc.
* Working Knowledge of electrical system studies using ETAP software and conversant with short circuit, load flow, motor starting & voltage drop calculations.
* Participate in meetings with clients and contractors as on when needed.
* Maintain an awareness of technological advances and industry best practice.

**Mandatory skills**

* Possess good knowledge of international codes & standards and Industry practices focussing particularly on Middle East Markets.
* Experience in selection of electrical equipment.
* Interdisciplinary knowledge to coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, C&I, Civil and Commissioning teams.
* Excellent Skill in oral and written communication, demonstrated skill in leadership.
* Self-propelled, plans, develop, schedule & coordinate the review engineering work within discipline on a multi discipline project or assignment.
* Technical design review of electrical equipment/systems on large scale projects. Reviews and approves key engineering drawings and calculations, including field and design documents relating to the discipline.
* Knowledge of related construction practices and the economics involved.
* Attend and contribute to team and project meetings and site visits.
* Knowledge of industry /regulatory codes and standards, and design and/or layout criteria.
* Knowledge of health & safety requirements and compliance.
* Lead by example and ensure QMS and Project Lifecycle compliance across team and projects.

**Desired skills**

* Experience in Advisory roles for Power plants & Substations particularly for Middle East Region.
* Knowledge of IPP contracts is an advantage.
* Knowledge of IEC codes and practices followed in middle east region.

  

* A recognized degree in electrical engineering discipline, from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant work experience of minimum 5 years for Owner/detailed engineering preferably in an engineering consultancy firm of power or substation projects.
* Accountable for assigned activities in electrical engineering discipline. Applies broad and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices to project engineering.
* Work in multi discipline team and support the discipline on the project to resolve technical questions and as required to assist work.

title: CAD Technician
description:
* Create, review, and revise detailed AutoCAD drawings for Engineering projects, ensuring compliance with standards and specifications.
* Produce 2D and 3D CAD drawings for geotechnical projects such as foundations, retaining walls, earthworks, tunnels, slopes, ground improvement, etc.
* Prepare site plans, trial pit logs, borehole logs, and geotechnical cross‑sections.
* Assist engineers by preparing geotechnical profiles, sections, and geological models.
* Collaborate with project engineers and designers to gather requirements, clarify project specifications, and ensure accurate representation of design intent.
* Maintain drawing accuracy, quality, and consistency by adhering to organizational and regulatory standards.
* Update, organize, and manage drawing files, ensuring all documentation is accessible and up to date.
* Identify and communicate potential design issues, proposing solutions to ensure optimal project delivery.
* Assist in developing and refining AutoCAD workflows to improve efficiency and standardization within the team.
* Familiarity with geotechnical terminology
* Familiar with Upload/update drawings in Common Data Environments (CDE) like ProjectWise, BIM360, ACC, etc
* Must complete a high-quality self-check of own work with efficiency. Shall follow internal QC processes.
* Perform review of engineering drawings, as per markups made by the Checkers. Verify to ensure drawings modifications are accurately and correctly conducted.
* Reporting progress of work assignment to immediate supervisor. Understands the project schedule and budget requirements.
* Communicate with internal peers and project team and required to answer questions regarding deliverables.
* Capable of multi-tasking and managing multiple projects with the ability to accurately predict the time required to fulfil the individual scopes of work required.
* Be able to perform Material Take-Offs with CAD tool and excel.
* Actively participate in the design and provide input to the design team throughout the design process.
* Ensuring that quality procedures are implemented and maintained.
* Provide regular work status updates, including risks or concerns, to Lead Designer.
* Ensure that Health & Safety is embedded into all work practices in line with company policies.
* Develop expertise and stay up to date of developments in Drafting skills.
* Support the company’s approach to sustainability.
* Be able to communicate in a multi-disciplinary project team internally and externally.
* Be able to communicate to UK and other region.
* Be willing to learn and be polyvalent.
* Identify improvements (where possible) to enhance WSP service to clients. Complete accurate timesheets by set deadline.

  

Preference will be given to candidates with minimum 4+ year of experience in using CAD tool.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD software and familiarity with other CAD software.
* Proficiency in Civil3D software
* Proficiency in MicroStation software
* BIM tools (Revit, Navisworks)
* Detail-oriented with a strong understanding of Geotechnical drawings
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to work well within a team-oriented environment.
* Possessing a strong desire to learn, cultural awareness, an open-minded outlook, and strong English skills.

* Diploma or Bachelor of Engineering in Civil.

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

The Bids and Proposals Specialist will generally support the Bid Manager and/or Associate Bid Director leading the bid, having read and understood the client requirements. They will devise draft bid programmes, coordinate inputs from Subject Matter Experts and track progress against tasks and individuals for reporting to the Bid Manager. The Bids and Proposals Specialist will work collaboratively with technical and operational colleagues, writers, graphic designers and the leadership team. The role covers the full procurement lifecycle and proposals.

Aside from supporting bids, the role requires proactive engagement in ad hoc tasks around general bidding best practice, including but not limited to: driving bid knowledge management through the breakdown of bids into a bid library; collaboration with the knowledge team to log model responses and useful information; collaboration with graphic designers to support on ad hoc, simple graphics requirements; and supporting the leadership team to develop processes, tools and guides around bidding.

*This position will offer flexibility for hybrid work schedules to include both in-office presence and telecommute/virtual work. Candidates from Bangalore, New Delhi, and Mumbai are welcome to apply.*

* Lead mid-size proposals and task orders
* Participate in Go /No Go and green light analysis / readiness to bid assessment in partnership with bid / capture managers. Update CRM data as needed to maintain accuracy
* Contribute to pre-RFP proposal planning, including Four Rules win strategy development, applying win plan, messaging, and discriminators in deliverables
* Develop compliance matrices, identify required items, and create proposal plan and schedules
* Create drafts and organize narratives and sections for experience, people, executive summaries or cover letters. Develop section content plan/ templates to guide writers
* Organize and manage content for reviews and manage the recovery and implementation of comments and finalization of documents and compliance
* Coordinate with subcontractors to gather required data and provide guidance
* Collaborate with graphic designers to support graphic design requirements and coordinate final productions. May also follow branded templates in performing document layout
* Collaborate with knowledge team to log model responses and useful information
* Provide support in general bidding practices by driving bid knowledge management through the breakdown of bids into a bid library
* Update and maintain bid and project profile libraries, including filing completed proposals and CVs
* Maintain trackers and identify useful/updated standard content for enhancement of bid resources
* Undertake support research, including the collection of project profiles, mining Salesforce, searching internal databases
* Maintain standard supporting documentation for bids such as company certificates, standard responses, company reports
* Perform moderately complex tasks in compliance with service level agreement, process, policies, and procedures
* Contribute specialized expertise to different assigned projects and process improvement initiatives. Provide key updates to Team Lead and Manager
* Escalate issues and recommend resolutions to the Team Lead. May support junior members of the team in addressing routine issues within the assigned processes

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Business, Marketing, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least four (4) years Bid support experience, preferably within a professional services firm in a similar industry
* Strong knowledge of marketing best practices and procedures, work processes, and tools as related to proposal management of RFQ/P responses
* Experienced in proposal and presentation writing and production
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Office tools such as Word and PowerPoint
* Understanding of graphic design and an eye for communicating content visually – can effectively use our brand guidelines and work with our corporate identity
* Skills in Adobe Creative especially InDesign and Salesforce experience would be highly regarded

 **Additional Information**

Attributes:

* Ability to be thorough and meticulous in completing assigned tasks and with the ability to propose ways to prevent or eliminate errors, discrepancies & issues. (Attention to Detail)
* Ability to maintain good customer relationship and initiate ways to improve customer experience (Customer Service)
* Ability to maintain a high level of collaboration among multiple internal and external stakeholders to effectively arrive at solutions and develop initiatives. (Collaboration)
* Ability to effectively communicate within a varied audience and internal and external customers using different platforms. (Communication)
* Ability to identify and resolve moderate and complex issues by applying best practices and technical expertise and may recommend solutions for unique scenarios. (Problem Solving)

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, and service recognition awards.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

title: Sr. Kubernetes Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About the Technology Organisation
  
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
About the Business Function
  
  
The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialised engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a Sr. Kubernetes Engineer, you will design, build, and operate Lilly's Kubernetes-based hosting platform across multiple clouds. You will own platform capabilities end to end: writing Kubernetes controllers in Go and platform automation in Go or Python, defining infrastructure as code, evolving CI/CD and GitOps delivery, and raising the reliability and security of the platform.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build, deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters end to end, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, networking, scaling and decommissioning, on a managed offering such as EKS or ROSA, or an equivalent platform.
* Develop and maintain custom Kubernetes controllers and operators in Go (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK), including CRD design, reconciliation logic, finalizers, and admission webhooks.
* Author and maintain automation, tooling, and services in Go or Python that streamline platform operations, onboarding, and review processes.
* Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize, with strong module design, state management, and policy-as-code practices.
* Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps pipelines using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Artifactory, and Checkmarx, with a security-first approach to software supply chain.
* Implement node and workload autoscaling with Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, HPA/VPA, and KEDA, including node image and upgrade strategies.
* Partner with application teams during onboarding, migration, and go-live, providing hands-on technical guidance and clear documentation.

How You Will Succeed
  
  

* Demonstrate deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, API machinery, and troubleshooting production issues.
* Write production-quality Go (and Python where needed), including tests, and apply good software engineering practices to platform code.
* Apply strong knowledge of AWS/Azure, including compute, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, private endpoints), IAM (IRSA, Pod Identity, workload identity), and managed Kubernetes services.
* Operate CI/CD and GitOps toolchains effectively, with sound judgment on release strategies such as progressive delivery, canary, and rollback.
* Use observability tooling to diagnose platform and application issues quickly, and drive improvements from the findings.

What You Should Bring
  
  
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4-7 years of experience in Platform or DevOps engineering, including running Kubernetes in production.
* Strong, hands-on experience with at least one managed Kubernetes offering (EKS, AKS, ROSA, or ARO); exposure to multiple is strongly preferred.
* Strong programming experience in Go, including hands-on experience building Kubernetes controllers and operators; Python for tooling and automation is a plus.
* Solid knowledge of Kubernetes internals and extension points: CRDs, controllers and operators, admission webhooks, finalizers, and the client-go and controller-runtime libraries.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management (Artifactory or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure core services, networking, and IAM.
* Practical experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, or equivalents) and log analysis in Splunk or similar.
* Experience with Linux, containers, and container runtimes, and strong troubleshooting skills across the network and OS layers.

Additional Information
  
  
This is a full-time employee position. Availability for flexible hours may be needed to support platform operations, and some on-call or non-standard-hours support may be required depending on platform incident volume.
  
  
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Security Architect
description:

We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

**We are looking for** Security Architect with 15+ years’ experience to help us build secure, resilient and trusted connected services by making security an integral part of architecture and delivery.

As a Security Architect, you will help define, evolve and govern the security architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from early business and design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution.

You will work closely with development teams, solution architects, product stakeholders and cybersecurity colleagues to translate security requirements, risks and regulatory obligations into practical, scalable and cost-effective architectural decisions.

**Your Impact**

* Ensure security architecture aligns with WirelessCar security strategy, policies, standards, architectural principles and risk appetite.
* Translate security requirements, risks and relevant regulatory obligations into concrete architecture patterns, controls and design decisions. Communicate security decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Review and approve security-relevant architecture designs and changes within your assigned scope.
* Embed security-by-design and privacy-by-design throughout the system and solution lifecycle.
* Guide Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Product Owners and delivery stakeholders in secure architecture decisions.
* Lead or contribute to threat modelling, security risk assessments, architecture reviews and design validation activities.
* Identify, prioritize and escalate architecture risks and deviations, and coordinate practical remediation actions.
* Monitor emerging threats, technologies and architecture patterns relevant to WirelessCar products, platforms and the automotive industry.
* Initiate and lead proof-of-concepts and evaluations of new security technologies and architecture approaches.
* Contribute actively to a culture of continuous learning, shared standards and secure engineering.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders and manage their expectations and collaborate with solution architect, delivery manager in achieving the goals.

**We believe that you bring**  
You are a technically experienced and pragmatic security professional who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You can balance risk, cost, complexity and delivery needs, explain why a security decision makes sense, listen to different perspectives and help teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and architects, and you see security architecture as something developed together with delivery teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience in security architecture, system architecture or cybersecurity roles across cloud-based, distributed or platform-oriented environments.
* An understanding of security and compliance frameworks relevant to the role, such as UNECE R155 ISO/SAE27001; TISAX & ISO27001 etc.
* Experience communicating technical security concepts, decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working collaboratively across engineering, architecture, product, governance, risk, compliance and operations teams in complex development environments.
* Experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud-native environments, including containers, Kubernetes, APIs, identity, network and data protection patterns.

  
**How You Work**

* You act with ownership, integrity and curiosity, balancing business enablement with robust security design.
* You take accountability for your architecture scope and make clear, risk-based decisions within established governance.

**Practical Information**

* Work Location: Bangalore,India.
* Standard working hours, with collaboration across globally distributed teams.

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

**About the role:**
