description:
**About the Role: Software Engineering Manager, Merchant Fulfillment**  
  
**Location:** Bangalore, India **Team:** Merchant Fulfillment
  
  
**About the Team**
  
  
The **Merchant Fulfillment** team is the "Engine Room" of Uber Eats. We own the mission-critical systems that power the entire **Order Lifecycle** -from the moment a customer hits "Place Order" to the moment the food arrives.
  
  
Our scope includes:
  

* **Uber Eats Orders (UEO):** The tablet application used by millions of restaurants to accept orders, manage prep times, and track couriers in real-time.
* **BYOC (Bring Your Own Courier):** The logistics platform that enables merchants (like Domino's or local favorites) to deliver orders using their own fleets.
* **Reliability & Defects:** The intelligence layer that prevents "bad orders" (cancellations, missing items) and automates financial disputes to save money for both Merchants and Uber.

  
**About the Role**
  
  
As an **Engineering Manager in Merchant FUlfilment** , you will lead a team of talented engineers building the critical infrastructure that the rest of the organization relies on.
  
  
You are a "Force Multiplier." Your systems will be used not just by merchants, but by 20+ other product teams at Uber who build on top of your platform. You will balance the need for **feature velocity** with **extreme reliability** , ensuring that as we scale to millions of merchants, our systems remain fast, secure, and rock-solid.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* **Build Platforms, Not Just Features: L** ead the design of scalable services (Backend) and architectures (Frontend) that serve as the standard for the entire org.
* **Drive Technical Strategy:** Own the roadmap for critical merchant fulfillment domains. You will decide when to refactor, when to cache, and how to architect for the next 10x scale.
* **Operational Excellence:** You will own the uptime and reliability of the Merchant Dashboard. You will drive initiatives to reduce latency, improve data freshness, and eliminate "White Screens of Death."
* **Lead & Mentor:** Manage a high-performing team of 8-12 engineers. You will be responsible for their growth, performance management, and creating a culture of technical rigor and psychological safety.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Partner with Product, Design, and other Engineering leads to prioritize "Tech Debt" and "Platform Capabilities" alongside business features.
* **Drive Reliability:** Design systems for **Offline-First** resilience. You will solve hard problems related to eventual consistency, idempotency, and data synchronization between the Cloud and the Merchant's Tablet.

**What You Will Need**
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years of direct people management.
* **System Design:** Strong distributed systems knowledge. You understand the trade-offs in microservices architecture, data consistency, and caching strategies at scale.
* **Full-Stack Empathy:** While you may lean Backend (Go/Java) or Frontend (React/Mobile), you are comfortable leading a team that operates across the stack.
* **Product mindset:** Experience working with Operations/Business teams to reduce costs or improve efficiency. Not just "pure tech" leaders, but "business-tech" leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Logistics/Order Management:** Experience building Order Management Systems (OMS), Supply Chain tech, or Real-time Logistics platforms.
* **Mobile-Backend Synergy:** Experience designing APIs specifically for mobile/tablet clients (handling patchy networks, optimistic UI updates).
* **Fintech/Ledger:** Experience with financial reconciliation or dispute systems (useful for the Post-Order charter).

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: RTL Power Engineer - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for talented RTL Engineers to help build Velaura's next generation Physical AI SoC. You will work closely with architects, performance modelers, software engineers, verification engineers and physical design teams to turn architectural concepts into production silicon.

In this role you will own power management of the SoC at every level, delivering silicon that meets its performance targets well within the power budgets allocated to it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design the on chip power management hardware for the Velaura SoC including digital power meters, activity monitors and throttlers.
* Design hardware and software control loops around temperature sensors that hold the die under a defined thermal limit.
* Design controls that keep the design under defined activity and average power limits as well as instantaneous di/dt limits.
* Work with architects, physical design and package teams on voltage droop behavior, power delivery and adaptive clocking response.
* Own clock and reset architecture including clock gating, PLL programming and management, and reset sequencing across power domains.
* Define and implement power state management including DVFS, power domains, retention and low power flows.
* Correlate power estimates across RTL, emulation and silicon, and build the telemetry that makes power and thermal behavior visible in the field.
* Work with firmware and software teams on the interfaces, policies and telemetry that drive power and thermal management.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong grasp of the physics and electrical engineering behind average power, peak current, thermal behavior and voltage droop, and of how these concepts relate while remaining independent.
* Experience designing power management hardware such as digital power meters, throttlers, or thermal and current control loops.
* Understanding of di/dt, IR drop and power delivery network behavior, and their impact on timing margin.
* Experience with clock and reset architecture including clock gating, PLL management and reset sequencing.
* Working knowledge of Verilog or SystemVerilog and modern RTL design methodology.
* Experience with power estimation and analysis flows from RTL through gate level.
* Strong debugging and problem solving skills across hardware and software boundaries.
* BS or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.

* Experience with firmware or PMIC interfaces and power management software.

title: Linux System and Hardware Administrator
description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** Linux System and Hardware Administrator

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:** Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**Reporting Line:** Head of Corporate Technology

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled

**Notice Period:** 30 days or less preferred, 60 days maximum

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes

**Application Deadline:** Open until Filled

**Shift Timings:** 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Career Growth That Matters**

You will be responsible for ensuring the resilience, performance, and integrity of critical systems while contributing to strategic change and operational excellence within the technology function.

To be successful in this role, you will need experience in:

* **Application Support & Service Delivery**
    
  Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.

* **Driving End to End Automation**

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.

* **Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering**

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.

* **Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**
    
  Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.

* **Change, Release & Environment Management**
    
  Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.

* **Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis**
    
  Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support**
    
  Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.

* **Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation**
    
  Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* **Risk, Compliance & Controls**
    
  Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).

* **Environment & Infrastructure Coordination**
    
  Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

* **Business Continuity & Resilience**
    
  Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.

* **Domain** Banking & Financial Systems

* **Technical Skills** AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL

* **Good-To-Have:** Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You may also require the following skills and experience:**

Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.

  
  

You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.

  
  

This role is based in our Bengaluru office.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEER II
description:
The Digital Data Network (DDN) Business Unit is seeking an R&D Product Development Engineer (PDE) to lead the design and development of innovative power connectivity solutions, including connectors, busbars, and cable assemblies. The role drives product development from concept through commercialization, with a strong focus on technical excellence, innovation, patent generation, and competitive benchmarking. The PDE will apply expertise in power interconnect systems, thermal management, materials, and manufacturing to develop robust, scalable, and market-ready solutions. The role also requires close collaboration with customers, suppliers, marketing, sales, manufacturing, and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* Responsible for product development of Power Connectors solutions from market definition through production and release:

o Work closely with the customer and TE sales/SA/FAE/PM in getting the right and clear VOC (voice of customer) and convert to a TE design conceptualization and preliminary product specification.
  
o Develop concepts and perform feasibility studies.
  
o Run mechanical and thermal simulations.
  
o Make the engineering evaluation/proposal to the customer.
  
o Create the detailed design including 2D/3D drawings and perform DFMEA/tolerance analysis.
  
o Build prototype samples and perform design verification & validation testing.
  
o Complete product qualification and finalize product specification.
  
o Provide technical support to the Operations team including Quality and Production for efficiency improvement and safe launch.
  
o Resolve product related issues to closure and manage the ECN/ECR/PCN (Engineering Change Notification/ Engineering Change release / Product Change Notification).
  

* Maintain a system level understanding of the customer application and the product design/concept necessary for providing a solution to the customers’ expectation.
* Follow the LEANPD / Stage gate Project Process to support the project team from the product development engineering (PDE) perspective to complete the new product development project on time, quality and budget. Drive the development and release of product, scale-up through stage-gate reviews, ensuring milestone commitments are maintained.
* Execute technical documentation to fully detail design drawings and requirements, engineering and product change notices, and design history files.
* Lead end-to-end product development from concept through commercialization, including design, prototyping, testing, and validation
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches
* Good in engineering analysis, simulations, and testing to validate product performance and reliability
* Conduct failure analysis and implement corrective actions for product issues
* Present technical findings and recommendations to senior management and customers

**Mandate Skills:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 5-7 years of relevant mechanical engineering work experience with electrical components, electrical devices, mechanical structure design, manufacturing tooling development (stamping, molding, assembly, plating), or manufacturing process development.
* Knowledge in product development in the power/electrical industry or other relevant mechanic design and development, including but not limited to, material selection, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, product qualification, etc.
* Knowledge of high-current power connector design and thermal management.
* Experience with connector contact design, spring mechanics, terminal retention, and mating interface development.
* Good understanding of Design Verification Testing (DVT), Product Qualification Testing (PQT), and reliability testing.
* Experience with power distribution, connectors, or related power management systems
* Proficient in 3D CAD applications (Creo preferred) with experience in 3D/2D including sheet metal, PDM link Data Management
* Knowledge in material selection for resins and sheet metals as per industry standards for right product application.
* Proficient in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T).
* Good in DFMEA & Technical risks identification & Mitigation.
* Patent search, invention disclosure, and IP awareness.
* Basic knowledge on finite element analysis software (Ansys, Workbench), Good at interpreting results.
* Basic knowledge in manufacturing process (Injection molding, stamping, plating, assembly, etc.).
* Ability to work in a global environment – able to accommodate varying time zones and capable of collaborating with individuals across geographies.
* Proficient problem solver – able to handle moderate complexity situations and use data analytics and critical thinking to reach logical conclusions with general direction.
* Familiarity with industry standards and certifications (OCP, IEC, UL, VDE, etc.)
* Good knowledge of electrical principles, power systems, and thermal management

  

**Nice To Have Skills/Experience:**

  

* Familiarity with switch and or server equipment.
* Basic knowledge of quality tools (DFMEA, 6 sigma, DOE, 8D, etc.).
* Solid presentation skills with an ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences in English.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Are you looking for a dynamic, international career where your contributions truly matter? Join Avolta and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel - together.

ROLE SUMMARY  
The Scraper Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web data extraction solutions for competitor  
and market intelligence. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Python and Scrapy, along with the ability to  
select the most suitable extraction approach based on the target website. Scrapy/direct HTTP extraction should be  
used where appropriate, while Selenium or Playwright should be used for JavaScript-heavy, dynamically rendered,  
or interaction-dependent websites where HTTP-based extraction is not sufficient. The engineer will build reliable and  
maintainable scrapers, validate extracted data, troubleshoot website changes and blocking issues, and ensure output  
meets defined data quality standards.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
Web Scraping & Competitor Onboarding - 65%  

* Analyse assigned websites using Chrome DevTools (Network, Elements and Console) to determine whether data is

best extracted from HTML, XHR/Fetch requests, REST/JSON APIs, embedded JSON, or browser-rendered content.  

* Develop production-grade spiders using the Scrapy framework, including Spiders, Requests/Responses, Items,

Item Loaders, Pipelines, Middlewares and project/settings configuration.  

* Use Selenium WebDriver or Playwright for Python when required data cannot reliably be obtained through Scrapy

or direct HTTP requests.  

* Handle JavaScript-rendered content and browser interactions such as dropdowns, pop-ups, location/airport

selection, load-more buttons and infinite scrolling.  

* Implement and maintain location-specific crawls where product assortment, pricing, promotions, availability or

content varies by country, region, airport, store or selected location. Handle location selection through URLs, APIs,  
cookies, sessions or browser interactions as required.  

* Handle product variants accurately, including size, volume, pack size, colour or other product options, ensuring

relevant variants and their associated prices, availability, identifiers and attributes are extracted and mapped  
correctly.  

* Build robust XPath and CSS selectors capable of handling nested and changing HTML structures.
* Implement numbered, next-page, load-more, infinite-scroll and API/cursor-based pagination.
* Extract structured product information such as product name, brand, category, regular/promotional price, currency,

availability, product URL, image URL, SKU/product identifiers and other required attributes.  

* Work with requests/httpx and direct APIs where browser automation is unnecessary; parse nested JSON and

embedded JavaScript/JSON objects.  

* Implement request/session management including headers, cookies, retries, timeouts, redirects, throttling and proxy

configuration.  

* Develop reusable scraping components and avoid duplicated website-specific logic wherever practical.

Data Quality, Testing & Validation - 20%  

* Validate scraper output against the source website and defined data schema.
* Implement field validation, normalization and cleaning for prices, currencies, identifiers, availability and text fields.
* Handle missing fields, malformed responses, duplicate records and unexpected page structures gracefully.
* Write unit tests using pytest for parsers, extraction logic and reusable components.
* Perform record-count, pagination, location and variant validation to ensure complete and accurate extraction.
* Investigate QA-reported discrepancies, identify root causes and implement fixes with appropriate logging and error

handling.  
Maintenance & Production Support - 15%  

* Troubleshoot and repair scrapers affected by website structure, frontend or API changes.
* Diagnose HTTP errors including 403, 429, redirects, session failures and rate limiting.
* Identify blocking/anti-bot behaviour and implement approved mitigation approaches such as realistic headers,

cookies, session handling, throttling and proxy rotation.  

* Debug browser/network requests to identify API and frontend behaviour changes.
* Maintain clean, reusable and well-documented code; participate in peer reviews and follow established Git

workflows.  
TECHNICAL SKILLS - REQUIRED  
Python - Strong hands-on experience  

* Python programming, OOP, exception handling, modules/packages and reusable code design.
* JSON/XML processing, regular expressions and data cleaning/normalization.

Scrapy Framework - Strong hands-on experience  

* Spiders, Requests/Responses and callbacks; Items / Item Loaders; Pipelines.
* Downloader/Spider Middleware, settings and per-spider configuration.
* Retries, error handling, concurrency, AutoThrottle/download delays, cookies, sessions, proxies, logging and

debugging.  
Selenium & Playwright - Hands-on experience  

* Browser automation for dynamic and JavaScript-heavy websites.
* Element identification and interaction, wait strategies, dropdowns, pop-ups and dynamic elements.
* Load-more/infinite scroll, cookie/session handling, headless execution and browser automation troubleshooting.

Web & API Extraction  

* Strong XPath and CSS selectors; HTML/XML parsing using lxml and/or BeautifulSoup.
* Chrome DevTools, XHR/Fetch and REST/JSON API analysis, nested JSON and HTTP fundamentals.
* Pagination, API/cursor pagination, headers, cookies, sessions, status codes and redirects.

Location & Variant Handling  

* Experience extracting location-dependent product, pricing and availability data.
* Ability to identify how websites maintain location context through APIs, URLs, cookies, sessions or browser

selections.  

* Experience extracting products with multiple variants and correctly mapping variant-level attributes, identifiers, prices

and availability.  
Engineering Practices  

* Git branching, commits, pull requests and code reviews.
* pytest/unit testing, logging, exception handling and debugging.
* Basic Linux command-line skills and ability to independently analyse unfamiliar websites.

**Your work profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced Unix Administrator – Senior Consultant to support, manage, and optimize enterprise Linux/Unix environments across on-premises data centers and hybrid infrastructures. This role requires strong hands-on expertise with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu Server, Linux clustering technologies, and advanced troubleshooting skills. The Senior Consultant will provide L2/L3 technical support, drive operational excellence, ensure platform stability, and contribute to automation and modernization initiatives within the Unix/Linux tower. Key Responsibilities UNIX, Red Hat HA, SUSE HA, Red Hat Clustering, Veritas Clustering, Apache Unix/Linux Server Administration

* Perform installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server environments.

* Conduct OS patching, kernel updates, security hardening, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.

* Manage logical volumes (LVM), file systems, RAID configurations, and storage integrations. Clustering & High Availability

* Implement, configure, and support Linux clustering technologies, such as: o Red Hat Cluster Suite (Pacemaker/Corosync) o HAProxy / Keepalived o DRBD, fencing agents, failover resources

* Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and cluster performance diagnostics.

* Troubleshoot cluster failures, split-brain issues, node communication problems, and HA resource constraints. Scripting, Automation & Tools

* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell/Bash, Python, and Ansible.

* Automate routine tasks such as patching, configuration deployment, monitoring, and health audits.

* Work with configuration management and orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, SaltStack preferred). Networking & Security

* Manage Linux network configurations including bonding, VLANs, routing, DNS configurations, and firewall rules (firewalld/iptables).

* Implement OS-level security best practices, SELinux policies (enforcing/permissive), and vulnerability remediation.

* Support authentication integrations with LDAP/AD/Samba/Kerberos. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

* Monitor system health, performance, logs, and hardware components using tools like Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, or Red Hat Insights.

* Handle L2/L3 escalations for OS performance issues, application failures, kernel panics, filesystem corruption, and networking defects.

* Provide root-cause analysis (RCA), incident resolution, and support planned maintenance activities. Documentation & Collaboration

* Maintain accurate SOPs, topology documentation, server inventories, and configuration guides.

* Collaborate with middleware, database, storage, network, and security teams for cross functional troubleshooting.

* Participate in DR drills, compliance audits, and capacity planning exercises. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server in enterprise environments.

* Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.).

* Proficiency with Shell/Bash scripting, and familiarity with Ansible automation.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals: processes, memory, storage, networking, and kernel-level troubleshooting. • Experience with LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS), permissions, SELinux, systemd, and performance analysis tools.

* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment.

  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

* 6+ years of experience in Unix/Linux system administration.

* Hands-on experience with clustering and HA implementations in production.

* Exposure to virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/KVM) and cloud basics is an advantage.

* Familiarity with ITIL practices (Incident, Change, Problem). Good to have

* Certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer (LFCE), or equivalent.

* Experience with containerization (Docker/Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus.

* Experience in managed services or large enterprise IT operations.

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.

* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).

* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).

* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

### **Your Task**

We are seeking a **Senior AI Multi Agent Developer** for the MINDR Intelligence Stream project. The Intelligence Stream serves as the Decide and Act layer of MINDR. As a Senior AI Developer, you will not be designing isolated models or building data pipelines. Instead, you will own the agentic reasoning core, designing and implementing a production-grade Multi-Agent Runtime that orchestrates specialized diagnostic agents, performs automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and recommends human-in-the-loop (HITL) remediation actions.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Design and Develop the Multi-Agent Runtime:** Build, optimize, and maintain the deployable Python runtime hosting MINDR agents. You will handle agent lifecycle management, instantiation, state persistence, audit trail logging, and termination.
* **Orchestration and Agent Tooling:** Build and scale the Principal Agent that dynamically schedules tasks and aggregates results from downstream child agents (Performance, Topology, Alarm, Ticket, CX, and Event Scout) using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Implement the RCA Inspector:** Program the reasoning engine that consumes multi-source incident context and compares it against structural playbooks (e.g., CDN traffic shift patterns) and historical incidents to produce ranked, explainable root cause hypotheses.
* **Construct Stream-to-Stream API Contracts:** Maintain tight integration and high API hygiene with neighboring streams including Data Stream (reacting to Anodot anomaly streams via Pub/Sub and consuming Silver layer telemetry), Knowledge Stream (issuing semantic queries to the Knowledge Graph for network topology context), and Experience Stream (exposing WebSocket/SSE streams of agent run lifecycle events for real-time operator dashboards).
* **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Remediation:** Build safe, secure integrations for the Remediation Agent to interface with Tardis-fronted APIs (e.g., triggering reroutes, raising CASM tickets, or partner notifications) under strict human approval gates.

### **Your Profile**

We are seeking a **Senior AI Multi Agent Developer** with deep expertise in building production-grade multi-agent systems, advanced Python development, and cloud-based streaming architectures for the MINDR Intelligence Stream project.

#### **Must Have Skills**

* Advanced Python development with deep expertise in building scalable production-ready backend services
* Hands-on experience developing multi-agent systems
* Experience with complex prompt engineering
* Experience with tool use logic and state management using frameworks or custom runtime loops
* Proven experience designing clean contract-driven APIs (gRPC, REST, WebSockets, or SSE)
* Experience building integrations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, specifically Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Functions
* Experience with streaming architectures (Kafka, CDI)
* Strong engineering focus on explainability and auditability
* Experience ensuring all agent intermediate steps and decisions are logged and reconstructable

#### **Nice to Have Skills**

* Familiarity with Network Topology
* Familiarity with IP Core Overload Protection
* Familiarity with telecommunications protocols (VoLTE service chains)
* Experience working with time series anomaly detection engines (e.g., Anodot, Prophet)
* Graph database query experience
* Experience with semantic queries
* Experience with graph-based reasoning

title: Senior Staff Security Architect
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

title: AV and Microsoft Teams Rooms Support Engineer
company: Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd
description:
Bay of Bangalore is hiring an on site L2 AV and collaboration support engineer for a professional enterprise workplace in Powai. The engineer will keep Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms and meeting space technology ready for everyday use, resolve incidents, support important executive meetings and town halls, and coordinate specialist vendors when an issue requires deeper programming or hardware repair.

This is a hands on operations role. We are looking for strong troubleshooting, ownership and customer service. The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every AV brand.

**Key responsibilities**

* Perform daily room health checks and provide incident support for conference rooms, boardrooms, town hall areas and other collaboration spaces.
* Support Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms across common enterprise devices including Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Neat and DTEN.
* Diagnose display, camera, microphone, speaker, cabling, touch panel, content sharing and connectivity issues using a structured troubleshooting approach.
* Provide planned technical support for executive meetings, town halls, webinars and hybrid events, including dry runs and live monitoring.
* Own incidents and service requests within agreed service levels, communicate clearly with users and document troubleshooting and resolution steps.
* Perform preventive maintenance, coordinate firmware updates and maintain accurate room, asset, spare and service records.
* Carry out basic network checks relevant to AV devices, including IP addressing, DHCP and DNS reachability, VLAN awareness and switch port identification.
* Coordinate with original equipment manufacturers, integration partners and service vendors for repair, warranty and escalation activities.
* Support room upgrades and new deployments through site checks, testing, punch lists and handover documentation.
* Provide simple user guidance and operating instructions for meeting room and collaboration technology.

**Essential experience**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in corporate AV and video conferencing operations, enterprise meeting room support or AV systems integration.
* Hands on support experience with Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Rooms in a live business environment.
* Ability to follow AV signal flow and isolate faults across compute, USB, HDMI, audio, network and peripheral layers.
* Practical experience with at least two enterprise AV ecosystems such as Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Neat, DTEN, Shure, Biamp or QSC.
* Experience using an IT service management or ticketing platform and working to service levels.
* Confident spoken and written English, calm user handling and professional support for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work on site in Powai and provide planned early or late event coverage when scheduled.

**Desirable experience and certifications**

* Dante Level 1 or Level 2, AVIXA CTS, or manufacturer training from Microsoft, Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Shure, Biamp or QSC.
* Experience with Teams Rooms Pro Management, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync or a similar monitoring platform.
* Town hall and live event experience, including audio mixing, camera tracking or digital signage support.
* Basic CCNA level networking knowledge or previous experience in a banking or financial services environment.

**Please submit your CV with your current location, total AV and video conferencing experience, Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Rooms experience, notice period and two examples of meeting room or event issues you personally resolved**

* Demonstrate the building of clear and understandable simulation examples for prospective customers on simulations of their applications.

* Support prospective customers on the modeling of their applications with COMSOL Multiphysics®.

* Demonstrate use of the COMSOL Multiphysics® software and summarize its features in web-based workshops and other marketing and sales events, along with customer meetings.

* A willingness and ability to travel for limited periods of time to current and potential customers in order to run COMSOL-sponsored events and activities in India.

**Post-Sales Technical Support**
================================

* Support customers on use of the COMSOL Multiphysics® software for their applications, which includes a variety of multiphysics applications involving other engineering disciplines.

* Initiate and participate in subsequent sales opportunities to existing customers and other departments of existing customers.

**Training and Mentoring**
==========================

* Develop your technical and simulation knowledge and abilities through working with presales and support cases both independently and in cooperation with other sales and applications engineers.

* Run introductory training courses on COMSOL Multiphysics for new and existing customers.

* Develop and mentor new applications engineers, technical account managers, and sales engineers on the COMSOL Multiphysics® software and its uses in different application areas.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* A master’s degree in engineering or physics with one year or more experience in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling, numerical simulation, or multiphysics analysis of fluid flow and heat transfer applications.

* An understanding and coursework experience with fluid mechanics, heat transfer, turbulence modeling, and numerical methods, with experience in modeling applications such as conjugate heat transfer, natural and forced convection, nonisothermal flow, multiphase flow, and fluid–structure interaction (FSI).

* Logical problem-solving, strong interpersonal and communication skills on the phone, in person, and in writing. Strong organizational and time management skills, with a sense of urgency and the ability to effectively manage multiple technical projects and customer interactions.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PhD in engineering or physics with one year or more experience in modeling based on numerical methods, such as FEM or FVM, gained as part of project work at a commercial organization, government research facility, or university.

* Strong background in fluid mechanics and heat transfer, with a deep understanding of the physical mechanisms governing fluid flow and thermal transport. Experience with numerical methods and CFD modeling in two or more of the following applications: internal and external flows, turbulent flows, natural and forced convection, conjugate heat transfer, nonisothermal flow, rotating machinery, and multiphase flow.

* Experience with advanced physics modeling, including fluid–structure interaction (FSI), conjugate heat transfer, thermal stress/expansion, non-Newtonian flows, porous media, or species transport, and an understanding of the interaction between fluid flow, heat transfer, and structural or other physical phenomena.

* Experience with advanced CFD methods such as DEM, SPH, particle tracing, and other advanced numerical techniques for modeling complex fluid-flow applications.

* Experience working with COMSOL Multiphysics® software.

**Personal growth**

Supporting your success in your role as an Applications Engineer will be other simulation engineers and software developers who occupy the top echelons of their areas of expertise. You will see and participate, on a daily basis, the development and operation of many and varied cutting-edge new technologies. As an applications engineer, you will work with some of the most preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields who are simulating innovations and ideas for the future.

================

COMSOL is the leading innovator of multiphysics software for research and development (R&D). Our products are continuously pushing the boundaries of computer-aided engineering (CAE), so that our customers can solve challenging science and engineering problems and develop better products, faster. The COMSOL product family enables our end users to solve even the most sophisticated science and engineering problems, thanks to our intuitive and flexible user interface. We create the tools that drive new breakthroughs in physics and engineering, and we love what we do.

The COMSOL Group is a fast-growing, high-tech engineering software company that was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1986 and has grown to include 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world.

The COMSOL office in Bangalore is spacious, bright, and comfortable. Employees enjoy a casual dress code and relaxed atmosphere. Our corporate culture is innovative, vibrant, and cutting-edge. We are committed to encouraging creativity through an exciting and challenging environment in which individuals excel and grow. Our talented employees and an active learning environment are the keys to our success.

title: Observability Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Observability Engineer – APAC
  
**Location:** Bengaluru (Bangalore), India
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
As an Observability Engineer, you'll implement and operate enterprise monitoring and observability solutions across JLL's global technology infrastructure, with primary focus on Datadog. You'll bring fresh perspectives to existing monitoring approaches while independently solving complex infrastructure challenges that span multiple technology domains. Working with application, infrastructure, network, and cloud teams, you'll onboard services to monitoring, build insightful dashboards and intelligent alerts, troubleshoot telemetry pipelines, and create automation that improves operational efficiency.
  
At JLL, we believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive, and this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to operational excellence. You'll independently design monitoring solutions for sophisticated use cases, evaluate existing implementations for improvement opportunities, and ensure solutions are scalable and maintainable. We embrace more innovative ways of working and prioritize opportunities to strengthen and advance your career, making this position ideal for an engineer who enjoys learning new technologies, solving technical problems, and growing expertise in observability practices.
  
  
**What your day-to-day will look like:**  
**Independent Design & Implementation:**  
Design and configure comprehensive Datadog monitoring solutions independently across infrastructure, applications, networks, cloud platforms, logs, and digital experience capabilities aligned with enterprise standards
  
Create and maintain well-designed dashboards, monitors, alerts, integrations, and service health views that provide actionable visibility into system performance and health
  
Evaluate and enhance existing monitoring implementations, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce operational overhead, and increase observability effectiveness
  
  
**Technical Problem Solving:**  
Independently solve moderately complex to complex infrastructure and application monitoring challenges by analyzing metrics, logs, and traces while applying established methodologies
  
Install, configure, validate, and troubleshoot Datadog agents, integrations, APIs, collectors, and telemetry pipelines to ensure consistent and reliable data collection
  
Use comprehensive telemetry including metrics, logs, distributed traces, events, and network data to diagnose and resolve application and infrastructure issues
  
  
**Automation & Best Practices:**  
Build and maintain production-grade automated workflows using tools such as Rundeck, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, APIs, and Git-based processes
  
Apply observability-as-code principles and automation patterns to make monitoring configurations consistent, version-controlled, repeatable, and easier to maintain across environments
  
Identify and implement innovative automation solutions using AI-assisted approaches for operational tasks, reducing manual effort and improving consistency
  
  
**Team Leadership & Collaboration:**  
Onboard services and implement monitoring solutions by collaborating directly with application, infrastructure, network, and cloud teams to understand requirements and constraints
  
Serve as a technical resource for less experienced colleagues on troubleshooting techniques, operational procedures, and monitoring best practices
  
Lead moderately sized projects with defined scope and act as an informal mentor, delivering knowledge-sharing sessions on incident response, system design, and observability principles
  
Coordinate incident response activities and communicate complex technical information clearly to stakeholders across different technical backgrounds
  
  
**AIOps & Innovation:**  
Support and enhance AIOps capabilities including event correlation, anomaly detection, intelligent alert routing, noise reduction, and incident enrichment
  
Leverage AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, improve automation quality, enhance documentation, and optimize operational workflows
  
Contribute improvements to system reliability and operational efficiency by applying modern observability practices within established enterprise frameworks
  
  
**Required qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
  
3–5+ years of experience in observability, monitoring, infrastructure engineering, application support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related technology roles with demonstrated ability to work independently on complex challenges
  
Strong hands-on experience with Datadog or comparable enterprise observability platforms; direct Datadog experience is strongly preferred with proven ability to design and implement solutions independently
  
Solid working knowledge of observability concepts including metrics, logs, traces, telemetry, alerting, service health, and reliability principles with ability to apply them effectively
  
Demonstrated experience with automation and orchestration tools such as Rundeck and Ansible, with expanding skillset in operational automation
  
Proficient scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages with ability to create maintainable, production-quality automation
  
Practical experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, Git/GitHub, and CI/CD technologies with understanding of integration patterns and workflows
  
Solid exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP with proficiency in cloud-native technologies and end-to-end reliability solution implementation
  
  
**Preferred qualifications:**  
Experience across multiple observability areas such as infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, log analytics, network monitoring, cloud monitoring, or digital experience monitoring
  
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and configuration-as-code practices with understanding of observability-as-code principles
  
Experience supporting integrations between observability platforms and enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Rundeck, cloud services, or CI/CD tooling
  
Demonstrated exposure to AIOps concepts and AI-assisted engineering tools with practical understanding of their applications in observability and operations
  
Relevant certifications in Datadog, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), automation frameworks, or related technical areas
  
Demonstrated ability to create and maintain technical documentation, follow established operational procedures and standards, and communicate technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences
  
Proven ability to build strong working relationships across operational teams and collaborate effectively in globally distributed, culturally diverse environments
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
