title: Video & Data Core Network Operations Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a skilled Video & Data Core Network Operations Engineer to join our 24x7 Integrated Network Operations Centre (INOC) in Bangalore. This role is responsible for first-line monitoring, incident detection, fault analysis, troubleshooting, escalation and service restoration activities across Video, Data Core, Core Services and associated telecom network platforms. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining network availability, supporting service continuity and ensuring operational excellence through effective alarm monitoring, incident management and stakeholder coordination in a fast-paced telecom operations environment.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Monitor network alarms, events and service-impacting incidents across Video and Data Core platforms, ensuring timely detection in line with operational procedures and service level commitments.
* Detect, validate, register, update and track incidents accurately within approved ticketing systems.
* Perform first-level fault analysis, diagnosis and remote troubleshooting to support rapid service restoration and first-time resolution where possible.
* Correlate alarms and events to determine service impact, incident priority and the appropriate escalation path.
* Manage the incident lifecycle from detection through to closure, ensuring timely communication, documentation and ownership tracking.
* Escalate critical or unresolved incidents to resolver groups, vendors, suppliers or field support teams in accordance with established escalation procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams, external partners and support functions to support investigation, troubleshooting and restoration activities.
* Monitor and support Voice, Data Core, Charging, SMS and Core Services platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE, 5G and 5G Standalone network environments.
* Support technologies including SMSC, Voicemail, SGSN, MME, S/PGW, ePDG, PCRF, AMF, SMF, PCF, NRF, UDM, AUSF, EIR, HLR/HSS, STP, MSC, MGW, CSCF, MTAS and USSD.
* Participate in planned maintenance activities, alarm testing, health checks and post-change monitoring.
* Maintain accurate shift reports, operational updates and handover documentation covering critical incidents and pending actions.
* Ensure compliance with operational procedures, security requirements and business continuity standards.
* Support network inventory verification activities and raise discrepancies where identified.
* Work in rotational shifts, including weekends, public holidays and night shifts, to support continuous network operations.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related technical discipline.
* BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunications preferred.
* 4-7 years of experience within telecommunications operations, network operations centres or service operations environments.
* Good understanding of GSM, UMTS, LTE, 5G and Core Network architectures.
* Knowledge of SMS, Voice, Charging, Data Core and Core Services technologies and platforms.
* Experience in alarm monitoring, event correlation, incident handling and first-level troubleshooting.
* Understanding of ITIL Incident Management practices, including incident logging, prioritisation, escalation, communication and closure.
* Ability to assess service impact and make informed decisions in time-sensitive operational situations.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate with resolver teams, suppliers, vendors and operational stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate incident documentation.
* Good written and spoken English communication skills.
* Ability to perform effectively in a shift-based operational environment.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work within a highly critical telecom network operations environment supporting global services.
* Exposure to advanced Video, Data Core, Voice, Charging and 5G technologies.
* Experience collaborating with international stakeholders, vendors and technology partners.
* Participation in large-scale service assurance, incident management and operational transformation activities.
* Hands-on involvement with network monitoring platforms, troubleshooting tools and operational processes.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to customer experience and network service availability.
* Exposure to virtualised and containerised telecom network solutions.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced telecom network operations and service assurance practices.
* Incident and major incident management within mission-critical environments.
* Alarm correlation, fault diagnosis and service impact assessment methodologies.
* Operations and maintenance of 4G LTE, 5G and 5G Standalone Core technologies.
* Stakeholder management and operational communication in complex technical environments.
* Vendor management, escalation governance and service restoration coordination.
* ITIL-aligned operational service management capabilities.
* Exposure to virtualisation, cloud-native and container-based telecom technologies.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:
**Job Description Summary**

* Independently execute, and/or lead aero design of aero-derivative gas turbine engine combustors for land-based power generation applications, supporting overall engine development program, working in a diverse & dynamic global environment. Seamlessly communicate with stakeholders, provide insights, and propose innovative solutions to technical challenges using CFD as the design tool, strategize and constantly guide less experienced team members.
* Perform hi-fidelity CFD analysis to meet combustor aero performance requirements on durability, emissions, and operability. Contribute to development and improvisation of design methodologies with an intent to introduce new product design
* In this role you will be working with a multi-site global team to understand performance shortfalls, evaluate and propose design solutions to improve performance, validate combustor performance seen is tests with CFD, and facilitate entry into service for the improved designs

**Job Description**
===================

**Company Overview**

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

**Site Overview**

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.

**Role Overview:**

* Perform 3D CFD (RANS & LES) modelling of LNG fueled gas turbine combustors for land-based power generation applications involving airflow, fuel injection and reacting flow, combustion dynamics and emissions modelling, etc, to evaluate/propose new designs and understand impact on CTQs like fuel air mixing, emissions, combustion dynamics, durability, etc in order to support product improvements and entry into service.
* Lead & demonstrate engineering problem solving and decision making through active program execution, planning, communication with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Release down-selected designs or solution strategies for rig and engine testing, by going through proper review processes.
* Work with team members of varied experience: provide guidance to less experienced team members, and take help from more experienced members as required.
* Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Use prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy. Strive for continuous improvement of design processes and tools.
* Use engineering judgment and show ability to propose solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Use prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Demonstrate technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.

**Ideal Candidate:**

Proficiency in combustion/aero-thermal CFD modelling & design processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university with graduate level courses on combustion, fluid thermal sciences, AND >3yrs’ (3-8 yrs) industry experience in relevant disciplines like Combustion systems design, CFD analysis, testing and validation. .
* OR, PhD degree in combustion sciences (numerical or experimental) from an accredited university with >1 yrs’ (1-5 yrs) of industry or post-doc experience in relevant domain
* Proficiency in combustion/aero-thermal CFD modelling & design processes. Suitable competency in commercial CFD tools like Fluent/StarCCM, Spaceclaim, solid modelling tools like Unigraphics, 1D flow and reactor networks, or analytical design tools, and programming tools like C/C++

**Desired Qualification**

* Proficiency in Combustion/Aero-thermal fundamentals, Numerical methods
* Original thinker, passion for continuous improvement and willingness to adapt/innovate
* Independent worker with strong sense of ownership and responsibility
* Effective team-player, execution rigor & demonstrated program management skills while working within cross-functional, diverse and global teams.
* Passion for continuous improvements or demonstration of LEAN concepts understanding and application
* Global mindset with keen ability to innovate & challenge the status-quo.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. description:
**Job Title:**

Vice President

**Work Type:**

Permanent

**Location:**

WeWork-Cinnabar Hills, , Embassy Golf links Business Park, Off Intermediate Ring Rd, Challaghatta, Bengaluru, IND

**It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

**The Opportunity**

As a Senior Platform Engineer (SDE3) at NAB, you will be a technical leader, architect, and mentor, driving the evolution of the core platforms that power our entire engineering organization. This role moves beyond feature delivery to owning the design and implementation of large-scale, resilient, and secure systems. You will tackle complex technical challenges, such as building ephemeral on-demand environments from scratch, optimizing our multi-cloud Kubernetes strategy, and embedding security deep within the software development lifecycle. You will have a significant impact not only on our technology but also on our colleagues, actively mentoring junior engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence. If you are a seasoned engineer passionate about building world-class platforms and leading by example, this is your opportunity to shape the future of banking technology.

**What You'll Do**

As a SDE3, you will be responsible for the architecture and delivery of critical platform capabilities, ensuring they meet the highest standards of security, scalability, and reliability.

* **Lead Technical Design and Architecture:** Lead the architectural design and implementation of major platform initiatives. You will be responsible for creating robust, scalable, and secure solutions that solve complex problems for our internal development teams.
* **Build Risk-Mitigated Financial Systems:** Architect and build highly available and fault-tolerant systems that meet the stringent security, compliance, and risk mitigation requirements of a large-scale financial institution.
* **Drive DevSecOps Adoption:** Champion and implement DevSecOps best practices across the platform. You will design and integrate automated security scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance checks directly into our CI/CD pipelines to create a secure-by-default environment.
* **Master Multi-Cloud and Kubernetes:** Act as a subject matter expert on our multi-cloud (AWS and Google Cloud) infrastructure and our enterprise-scale Kubernetes platform. You will drive improvements in scalability, performance, and cost-efficiency.
* **Define and Manage Reliability:** Define, measure, and evolve platform Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets, using data-driven approaches to balance innovation speed with operational stability.
* **On Demand Environments:** Design advanced ephemeral environments with intelligent resource management and cost optimization
* **Mentor and Develop Talent:** Actively mentor SDE1 and SDE2 engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pair programming. You will play a crucial role in leveling up the technical capabilities of the entire team and fostering an inclusive, learning-based culture.
* **Influence Technical Strategy:** Collaborate with architects and other senior engineers to influence the technical direction of the NAB Engineering Foundation, evaluating new technologies and advocating for best practices.

**What You'll Bring**

We are looking for a technical leader with deep expertise in building and operating large-scale platforms and a passion for mentoring others.

* **Experience:** 8-11 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, backend or a related field, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, mission-critical infrastructure projects.
* **Multi-Cloud Expertise:** Deep, hands-on expertise in both AWS and Azure. You should have experience designing, deploying, and managing solutions that span multiple cloud environments.
* **Container Orchestration:** Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes and the broader cloud-native ecosystem. This includes a deep understanding of Kubernetes networking (CNI), security (RBAC, Network Policies), storage, and scalability patterns.
* **Secure CI/CD Architecture:** Extensive experience architecting and building secure, fully automated CI/CD pipelines for complex microservices architectures. You understand how to embed security and compliance into the entire lifecycle.

description:
**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT ARCTIC WOLF, YOU WILL:**

* Lead the engineering teams across site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout for our network security sensor platform.

title: Automation QA Test Lead
description:
**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

* Experience between 8 to 10 yrs.

* Define and prioritize testing tasks based on project requirements, risks, and timelines.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and design comprehensive test cases.
* Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers, providing guidance and support.

* Coordinate and manage the testing team’s activities, ensuring productivity and adherence to testing standards.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using C# and Selenium , Typescript of Java.
* Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing and delivery.
* Design and implement automated tests for RESTful APIs using tools like RestSharp or similar libraries.
* Validate API functionality, performance, and security through thorough testing.
* Oversee the execution of manual and automated tests, track results, and report defects.
* Generate and present detailed test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders.
* Ensure that defects are tracked and managed effectively throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives to provide QA input.
* Continuously evaluate and improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices to enhance testing efficiency.

* Identify and mitigate risks related to software quality and testing processes.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards and project requirements

**Required Skills:**

* Proficiency in C#,Typescript for developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming concepts, design patterns, and coding best practices.
* Expertise in using Selenium WebDriver for automating web application testing.
* Knowledge of Selenium Grid for distributed test execution.
* Familiarity with Selenium best practices for managing locators and handling dynamic content.
* Good knowledge in Database & SQL. Ability to create & mine data using SQL queries.
* Experience with RestSharp or similar libraries for creating and executing API test cases.
* Understanding of RESTful principles and common HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).
* Ability to validate API responses, handle authentication, and test error handling.
* Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks using tools like NUnit or MSTest for C#, WebDriver IO , Selenium
* Knowledge of integrating test automation with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD
* Proficiency with version control systems like Git for managing test scripts and collaborating with the development team.
* Familiarity with test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar for tracking test cases, execution, and defect management.
* Ability to write and execute SQL queries for data validation and verification.
* Understanding of performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter) for assessing application performance under load.
* Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in Scrum ceremonies like stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration and reporting

**Desirable Experience**

* Knowledge of Performance testing.
* Knowledge of Security testing.
* Knowledge of Mobile Automation Testing.

**Personal Skills:**

* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise.
* **Successful teamwork experience and demonstrated leadership abilities are required.**
* Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or any other equivalent degree.

  
**Additional Information**

**Personal Skills:**

* Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player.

**PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA**: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

The Engineering Cyber, Disaster Recovery, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist manages resiliency, disaster recovery, and cyber recovery testing for critical applications across Engineering and Business Units. The specialist helps application and infrastructure teams validate recovery strategies, understand recovery dependencies, establish order of recovery, maintain evidence, identify control gaps, and improve resiliency processes.

Division Description
  
The Technology Division
  
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge systems and processes that form the core of the business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. Team Description
  
Enterprise Technology Operations – Engineering Cyber, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist
  
Enterprise Technology Operations (Engineering Cyber, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist) is responsible for strategic initiatives that reduce risk and improve resiliency and recoverability across Engineering.
  
The team ensures effective recovery plans are in place, aligned with firm resiliency strategies, and validated across people, products, platforms, and functions.
  
The team drives adoption of standards, controls, platforms, and automation to improve recovery plan quality, reduce manual effort, support Business Continuity test credit, track exemptions, maintain evidence, and identify key application and infrastructure dependencies.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
IV. How You Will Fulfill Your Potential
  

* Manage education, awareness, and adoption of Engineering Resiliency, Disaster Recovery, and Cyber Recovery programs across Engineering divisions and Business Units.
* Engage business units and application teams to review, improve, and validate resiliency and recovery plans.
* Partner with technology business leaders to ensure critical applications are recoverable, recovery dependencies are understood, and recovery capabilities are tested regularly.
* Lead and coordinate infrastructure and application Disaster Recovery testing, Cyber Recovery testing, Data Center failover events, and building power-down events.
* Define test scope including shared service dependencies, upstream and downstream application dependencies, infrastructure dependencies, order of recovery, and critical recovery milestones.
* Work with application owners to adopt mandated controls and improve recovery procedures in line with resiliency and recovery requirements.
* Support Cyber Recovery testing by helping teams validate their ability to recover during cyberattack scenarios and execute recovery procedures.
* Coordinate and manage regulatory resiliency recovery tests, including:

o SIFMA industry-wide exercises
  
o SPOOR-related tests
  
o MAS-guided resiliency events
  

* Maintain test documentation and evidence in accordance with governance, internal audit, risk, and regulatory expectations.
* Liaise with internal and external teams to schedule test activities, monitor progress, document outcomes, and provide evidence supporting audit and risk management requirements.
* Partner with Operational Risk Management, Internal Audit, Risk Management, and Technology stakeholders to ensure resiliency activities align with firm strategy and application requirements.
* Conduct and coordinate Business Impact Analysis (BIA) reviews to understand workflows, recovery needs, dependencies, workarounds, and recovery alternatives during outage or cyber recovery scenarios.

o Business resiliency

o Testing approaches
  
o Risk mitigation strategies
  

* Support governance forums, resiliency committees, risk committees, threat awareness activities, assurance reviews, and planning discussions.
* Drive process improvements by identifying gaps in procedures, testing execution, control adoption, recovery documentation, and evidence management.
* Identify opportunities for automation and tooling to improve recovery planning and reduce manual effort.
* Oversee execution plans, readiness checks, business recovery validation, and management of resiliency-related escalations.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.

This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.

To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer's business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.

**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.

title: Application Support & Maintenance - RightFax
description:
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced Applications L2/L3 Support Maintenance Engineer with expertise in OpenText RightFax to provide operational support, administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and minor enhancements for enterprise faxing solutions. The role will be responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, performance, and security of the RightFax environment while supporting business users and coordinating with infrastructure, database, and vendor support teams.
  
  
The role requires working from the designated ODCs in Noida, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and adhering to the assigned 24x7 shift roster including weekend support.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Application Support Operations
  

* Provide L2/L3 support for RightFax applications and related faxing services.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service requests, and production issues within SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
* Monitor application performance, fax queues, integrations, and system health proactively.
* Support day-to-day RightFax administration and operational activities.

Application Maintenance
  

* Perform routine maintenance activities including patch validation, upgrades, configuration reviews, and system optimization.
* Plan and execute RightFax software patching, testing, and deployment activities.
* Manage application health checks and ensure optimal system performance.
* Identify and mitigate capacity, performance, and availability issues.

Incident, Problem Change Management
  

* Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and change requests using ITSM tools.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, network, and security teams for issue resolution.
* Participate in production releases and change implementation activities.
* Support disaster recovery, failover testing, and business continuity activities.

User Access Administration
  

* Create, modify, disable, and manage RightFax user accounts and fax numbers.
* Support access requests, role management, routing configurations, and mailbox management.
* Maintain user profiles, distribution lists, and fax routing configurations.

Vendor Stakeholder Coordination
  

* Act as the primary liaison with OpenText/RightFax vendor support for complex issues.
* Coordinate troubleshooting efforts between business users, infrastructure teams, and external vendors.
* Track vendor cases through resolution and communicate status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation Compliance
  

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, and support documentation.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security, audit, and data governance policies.
* Support audit requests and maintain operational records.

Technical Skills Required
  

* Strong experience supporting OpenText RightFax environments.
* Experience with:

o RightFax Enterprise Manager
  
o Fax Server Administration
  
o Fax Routing DID Configurations
  
o RightFax Integrations
  
o Fax Queue Monitoring
  
o User Administration
  

* Knowledge of:

o Windows Server Administration
  
o IIS
  
o Active Directory
  
o SQL Server
  
o SMTP/Email Systems (Exchange/O365)
  
o Networking fundamentals
  

* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of application monitoring and alert management tools.

Desired Skills
  

* Experience supporting RightFax integrations with ERP, EMR/EHR, Document Management, or Enterprise Applications.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation using PowerShell.
* Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
* Vendor management experience.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 5+ years of application support experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on RightFax administration and support experience.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have
  

* Healthcare enterprise support experience.
* OpenText RightFax certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise faxing environments.

description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you passionate about Digital workplace, Employee Communication, collaboration & Productivity and how it creates business value? Do you enjoy understanding how our tools helps our coworkers with simplified experience and boost productivity? Are you someone with a genuine interest in how Communication & Collaboration business can be improved through smart use of technology and processes?
  
  
Are you someone who takes ownership, drives solutions forward, and collaborates across functions to make things happen?
  
  
If the answer is yes, then keep reading—we might have the right role for you!
  
  
Our Digital Workplace – Communication & Collaboration plays a key role in ensuring that Digital Products & Services works effectively for the business.
  
  
We are now looking for a Product Specialist to take ownership and drive development within this area. In this role, you will ensure that our sub domain supports how we operate within IKEA’s technology-process-delivery ecosystem.
  
  
You will work closely with Product owners, Engineers, project managers, end-users, and cross-functional teams to understand needs, translate them into solutions, and drive adoption across the organization.
  
You bring strong communication skills and thrive in both technical and business discussions. You understand how to identify gaps, design solutions, and ensure that systems evolve with the business. Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are driven to deliver solutions that create real impact.

Key responsibilities (title) What you'll need to have

Key responsibilities (text) A Product Specialist for Communication, Collaboration & Productivity tools should ideally have skills across five areas:
  
  

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft 365 Products and solutions
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* A proactive mindset with strong ownership and problem-solving ability
* Track record of working in a similar role and delivering impactful results
* Product management
* Microsoft 365 expertise (technical skills)

* Analytics & Reporting

Technical skills
  

* Microsoft Teams

* Outlook
* Planner

Change management and adoption:

Analytics and reporting:

* Data storytelling

Team vision (text) We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

Let's connect A day in your life with us

Let´s connect As a Product Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring that the Communication & Collaboration sub domain delivers value to the business and supports efficient, data-driven decision-making.
  
You will take ownership of your area, continuously improving it by aligning capabilities with business needs. You will work hands-on with below key products ensuring solutions support how we actually operate.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across business, Product owners, Partners, project managers, end-users, and cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment and driving adoption.
  
  
This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, where your work directly impacts the delivery of high-quality solutions, technological advancements, and the organization's growth and efficiency.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  
  

* Measure, analyze and report on the performance of the Digital Products against business goals and KPIs
* Responsible for all product related analysis, utilizing both customer and product data
* Support the product owner in tactical decision making with analysis results and insights
* Supporting the Product Owner in writing user stories
* To develop extensive knowledge of the stakeholders’ (Product Manager & other business stakeholders)
* needs and interpret and share that knowledge with the product team, providing context, as needed to
* ensure what they develop and deliver what is expected
* To test, analyze and validate the actual impact of the product to make sure the product reaches its goals
* Where needed, (and directed by the Product Manager/Owner) work with co-workers to understand and
* quantify their needs and requirements, ensuring they are included and integrated into the product as
* needed
* Work cross functional to ensure that the agile team has what is needs and remove blockers that prevent
* the agile team to maximize the delivery of digital products

Beyond delivery, we expect you to:
  
  

* Take initiative and drive solutions forward independently
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams
* Focus on real business value — not just delivery
* Continuously improve processes and ways of working
* Ensure solutions are trusted, relevant, and actively used

  
We can offer you
  
  

* Opportunity to shape how Communication & Collaboration area in Digital workplace is developed and improved
* A collaborative, cross-functional environment
* Opportunities to learn, grow, and work with modern ways of working
* A workplace that values ownership, simplicity, and continuous improvement

  
At IKEA we believe that we’re better when we’re physically together for collaboration, dialogues and conversations. We believe in the power of human interactions; the informal chats, the energy, belonging and creativity generated by people being in the same place.
  
  
Our approach is that we spend majority of our time in the IKEA workplace and with flexibility to work from home when relevant.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.

### **What Will You Do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

### **Why SentinelOne?**

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

title: Engineer- Overhead Transmission
description:
Our Power and transmission team in GCC Sweden is looking for an overhead transmission line Engineer to support our wide portfolio of power networks and generation, and infrastructure projects, with a focus on our ever-growing portfolio of projects and clients seeking support with overhead transmission line design. Members of our power and transmission team not only perform the line design, but directly interact with colleagues in our other engineering teams, and with clients and regulators to understand requirements and negotiate solutions.

  

* Knows to Prepare Technical Abstract from feasibility study and Specification.
* Prepare Sag tension calculations using PLS CADD with define weathering conditions of specification as per international standards.
* Prepare loading calculations in excel & as well as in PLS CADD (Power Line Systems - Computer Aided Design and Drafting) software.
* Preparation of PLS tower models as per international codes is a plus.
* Spotting of Towers with Lidar Data.
* Preparing engineering documents related to transmission tower and foundation design.
* Attend site meetings (virtual) and provide ongoing design drawing changes / support as required during project build.
* Knowledge of all applicable engineering standards.

**Key Competencies / Skills:**

* Proven experience in the design of UK or Nordics Overhead Line Circuits (Towers and/or Poles) at any voltage up to 400kV.
* Knowledge of PLS Tower/PLS pole for Tower Development would be good, but not mandatory.
* Tower Spotting using PLS CADD is mandatory.
* Eurocode experience is preferred.
* AutoCAD, Wood transmission line pole design, Structural Design.

**Desired Skills:**

* Ability to negotiate effectively with internal and external clients.
* Deliver superior quality designs and deliverables that meet the technical schedule.
* Good communication skills, Team work, experience in working with countries outside India.

  

**Education** :

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, 5+ years of experience in the domain of activities.
* Pursuing Professional Qualification is preferred.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Principal Engineer - Groundwater Modelling
description:
The SWM Consulting (GCC) team is seeking an experienced professional to join our growing groundwater team within the SWM Consulting Team (UK Water). You will have 8+ years of professional experience on hydrogeology, groundwater modelling and/or knowledge of UK water sector. You will be expected to work with the wider UK team on developing conceptual groundwater models, interpretation of hydrogeological and geological data, support the GCC team, assist on bids/tenders and taking ownership of other catchment studies for the UK. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career and work with industry leading hydrogeologists and groundwater modellers with an excellent support network and mentorship from the UK team and an opportunity to develop the GCC team.

  

* The candidate should have more than 8yrs of demonstrable working experience on MODFLOW and hydrogeology
* Excellent communication and to effectively liaise with the UK team as well as internal and external Clients
* Developing groundwater models, managing and interpretation of hydrogeological data
* Skills on using automation tools for pre and post processing of large datasets (familiarity with 'Python, VBA, R' is desirable)
* Preparing detailed modeling reports, extraction of information from groundwater models, producing interactive reports/mapping and other GIS based outputs
* Works collaboratively within the team and proactively supports junior staff in developing their technical knowledge and understanding of tasks/projects assigned
* Welcomes more responsibility and has an ability to proactively manage professional development, seeking support from more senior staff where required
* Proactively contributes to the culture of safety, health and well-being of self and of individuals and the team; recognises the impact of what we do on the safety of others
* Communicates openly and keeps people informed, actively supporting a knowledge sharing and learning environment across WSP.

  

* Masters Degree in Water Resources Engineering or equivalent.
* Prior experience of flood risk management based projects, ideally with exposure to standards, specifications and software tools used in the UK Water Industry. A Minimum of 6+ years of relevant industry experience is desirable.
* Working towards professional accreditation with CIWEM or with an ability to get chartered within 1-year (Desirable)
* Strong working knowledge of on UK groundwater modelling, hydrogeology and geomorphology.

  + Groundwater Modelling
  + Abstraction Studies
  + Low Flows Hydrology
  + Surface Water Management
  + GIS based desk-studies
  + Detailed Project/Modelling Reporting
  + Project Management/Understanding of Project Financials
* Strong experience in appropriate modelling software (MODFLOW, 4R, FEFLOW, QGIS, ArcGIS, Python/VBA)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are essential.
* Competent in MS Office.
* Ability to work on own initiative on technical matters, ability/background in collaborating with other design disciplines on multi-disciplinary projects
* An ability to develop the GCC team and proactively take charge of recruitment and team building, technical development and mentoring.

title: Java Team Lead (Telecom)
description:
NEED ONLY IMMEDIATE JOINERS

Mandatory Skills: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Redis, Microservices, Telecom Domain 4G/5G/3GPP, Policy & Charging / PCC / PCF / PCRF

* Notice period: NEED ONLY IMMEDIATE JOINERS
* Location: Bangalore based candidates only
* Work Mode: Hybrid (Initial 3 month complete WFO)
* Interview mode: Virtual
* Tech Lead: 1518 LPA 3 openings
* Team Leader (7-10 Years Experience)

Telecom | Java Spring boot | Cloud Native | Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Team Leader with strong expertise in Spring Boot, Redis, and Kafka, complemented by solid architectural skills and preferably a background in the telecommunications domain. The role involves leading a team to design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable microservices. You will be instrumental in driving technical excellence, ensuring best practices, and delivering missioncritical telecom applications that meet stringent performance and reliability standards.Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop high-availability, low-latency telecom applications that are critical to core network operations and service delivery.
* Drive project planning and task delegation, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality deliverables.
* Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers/developers, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative team culture.
* Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Implement and manage Redis for caching and data storage.
* Develop and maintain Kafka-based event streaming pipelines for real-time data processing.
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues and bugs.
* Optimize microservices for speed, efficiency, and resource utilization
* Contribute to the development of a robust and scalable architecture.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing.
* Optional: Experience in the telecommunications industry.

Required Skills & Experience

* Telecom Knowledge: Understanding of 3G/4G and 5G network & 3GPP specifications required for Policy & Charging System.
* Proficiency in Java: Strong understanding of Java programming principles and best practices.
* Spring Boot: Extensive experience with Spring Boot framework, including Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Cloud.
* Microservices Architecture: Solid understanding of microservices architecture, including design patterns, communication protocols, and deployment strategies.
* Redis: Experience with Redis as a caching layer and data store.
* Kafka: Experience with Apache Kafka for building event-driven applications and streaming pipelines.
* Database: Experience with database technologies (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Architecture Experience: Proven ability to design and implement scalable and robust architectures.
* Strong Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with other developers and stakeholders.

Education

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Have you previously applied to TAYANA MOBILITY-Bengaluru, either directly or through a consultant/ vendor/ employee?
* In how many days can you join? Do not write "Serving Notice". We need 03 immediate joiners. (VIRTUAL INTERVIEWS)
* What is your CCTC?
* What is your ECTC (max budget is 18 LPA only)?
* Do you have 7–10 years of overall software development experience, with hands-on Java development experience?
* Do you have hands-on experience with both Java and Spring Boot in developing production applications?
* Have you worked on telecom core-network applications involving 3G/4G/5G and relevant 3GPP specifications?
* How many years of hands-on experience with Policy & Charging systems such as PCC, PCF or PCRF?
* Do you have hands-on experience with Kafka, Redis and microservices in a production application?
* Have you formally led a team of developers, including task allocation, technical guidance, mentoring and delivery ownership?
* What is your current location? Candidates currently based in Bengaluru will be preferred.

Work Location: In person

title: Intermediate Professional, Digital Solutions
description:
WSP is seeking an AI Engineer to develop and support production-oriented Generative AI solutions for the Middle East AI portfolio from the Bengaluru GCC. The role will work across AI products, agents, automation workflows and enterprise integrations, with emphasis on secure engineering, measurable quality and responsible AI.

  

* Develop GenAI applications, agents and automation workflows using approved designs and engineering standards.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, structured outputs and prompt patterns to improve solution reliability and usability.
* Integrate AI components with enterprise systems, APIs, approved vector search services and governed data sources.
* Build and maintain ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured content.
* Create evaluation datasets and execute repeatable testing for accuracy, grounding, safety, latency and solution quality.
* Apply responsible AI controls including validation, guardrails, content filtering, traceability and human oversight.
* Develop clean, reusable and well-documented Python components and participate in code reviews.
* Support deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation of AI solutions.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of relevant software, data or AI engineering experience, including internships or strong project experience.
* Working knowledge of Python, REST APIs, SQL and software engineering fundamentals.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
* Exposure to Azure AI services, Git-based development, CI/CD and cloud security principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**WSP-Aligned Technology Stack**  
The role will use and support the approved enterprise stack below. Equivalent technologies may be considered only where formally approved through WSP architecture, security and governance processes.

**Cloud platform**

Microsoft Azure

  

**AI services**

Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Machine Learning and approved Azure AI services

  

**Application hosting**

Azure App Service, Azure Functions and Azure Kubernetes Service where architecturally approved

  

**Data and security**

Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, SQL and approved NoSQL services

  

**Engineering lifecycle**

Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Azure Monitor and approved observability services

  

**Architecture**

REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and serverless patterns, secure API-first integration

**Expected Outcomes**  

* Deliver maintainable AI components that progress from prototype through controlled production deployment.
* Improve solution quality through structured evaluation, monitoring and iterative optimisation.
* Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and patterns across the Middle East portfolio.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Microsoft Azure or Azure AI certification.
* Experience with agentic AI orchestration, document intelligence or enterprise search.
* Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management and production monitoring.
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary, agile or globally distributed teams.

**Ways of Working**  

* Collaborate effectively with Middle East stakeholders, GCC delivery teams, product owners, engineering specialists and enterprise technology functions.
* Work within WSP standards for architecture, cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI, quality assurance and delivery governance.
* Communicate clearly, document decisions and support transparent delivery reporting across distributed teams.

title: Senior Transport Planner
description:
We are seeking a Senior Transport Planner to support our Transport Planning and Mobility team in Noida/Mumbai/Bengaluru to work alongside our Middle East discipline. Middle East transport team offers clients a wide range of multi-disciplinary services including strategic planning of greenfield and brownfield area master planning, transportation corridor developments such as highways, bridges and tunnels, public transport systems, regional / strategic transport modelling (VISUM, CUBE), transport modelling of local networks (VISSIM, SYNCHRO, SIDRA, HCS) and, pedestrian modelling (LEGION, VISWALK).

The successful candidate will be working in a team environment to develop and deliver projects through various stages of design from feasibility to planning/detailed design and onto construction.

  

Support the delivery of a diverse portfolio of transport planning projects across the business.

* Opportunities to contribute to a range of projects, including business cases, transport assessments, strategic network studies, development control, consultations, active travel strategies, public transport studies, research, travel behavior change initiatives, etc.
* Assess the transportation impacts of proposed developments and provide recommendations for infrastructure improvements, prioritizing active and sustainable transport modes.
* Fulfill a technical role across multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring a challenging and engaging workload.
* Conduct technical reviews to maintain the highest quality standards in project deliverables.
* Prepare high-quality, client-facing technical reports and documentation for active travel and transport planning schemes.
* Understand project contracts and scope, ensuring deliverables align with client expectations.
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients and colleagues, collaborating across teams and disciplines to deliver joint projects effectively.
* Ensure the timely and budget-conscious delivery of high-quality project outcomes.
* Support line managers in resource planning, identifying and escalating concerns related to workload or utilization as needed.
* Provide feedback to line managers on team performance and professional development needs.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical project risks in collaboration with the line manager.
* Contribute to the company’s sustainability initiatives through transport planning strategies.
* Actively participate in team and project meetings, providing valuable insights and expertise.
* Take responsibility for line management duties, including mentoring, coaching, and supporting the career development of junior team members.

  

Key Competencies / Skills

* Bachelor's Degree with Master's in Transport Planning/Transportation Engineering.
* Good understanding of master planning principles, transit-oriented developments, micromobility planning and sustainable transportation systems
* Understanding of the technical transport planning environment
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, especially in MS Excel
* Ability to write high-quality technical reports
* Capable of working both independently and within a team
* Strong written communication skills
* Good understanding of geometric design principles, urban roadways design principles and highway components.
* Familiarity with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) tools such as ArcGIS.

Experience

* 6-10 years of experience as a transport planner
* Experience working for international projects in Middle East is beneficial but not essential.

title: AI Software Solutions Engineer
description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact** :

As an AI Software Solutions Engineer, you will focus on optimizing AI solutions using Intel products, working closely with open-source frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve designing and developing features for Intel's AI frameworks software stack, enabling and optimizing deep learning models, and enhancing AI frameworks for Intel's cutting-edge GPUs and accelerators. description:

===========================

MRO(Maintenance, repair, overhaul) Product Support Engineer (PSE) is responsible for providing technical leadership to in-service technical management of GEnx CDN & HPT components, throughout the product life cycle. PSE is also responsible for delivering technical support to shops, ensuring product safety, reliability, durability, shop customer responsiveness, cost of ownership, and productivity.
  
  
The PSE will own some of CDN & HPT (ATA’s), and will act as an interface with Engineering Organizations (Design, Repair, Analytics, Materials Engineering, PSE Module leader etc.), Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul Shops (MRO), Digital Services Solutions (DSS), based on business needs to support the fielded engines.  
  
In this role, you will report to Sub-Section Manager, GEnx MRO PSE – SEEMS Section, JFWTC, Bangalore.

**Job Description**
===================

**Site Overview**

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Owning the in-service product reliability and the technical communication on field issues with our shop
* Own and drive customer outcomes for off-wing services delivered through the global MRO network, ensuring performance against Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost commitments.
* Lead MRO customer responsiveness for inquiries and technical data requests (DRs), ensuring timely, accurate, and professional communication that meets or exceeds customer expectations.

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Globals:**

Globals has drastically grown from a small home office to a globally recognized enterprise offering world-class quality solutions on Cybersecurity, Cyberwarfare, ERP Systems, AI, and Enterprise Application Development for various industries including Defence, Education, Government, Financial Services and Transport Industries. Globals has enabled its customers to be game-changers in their industry through its disruptive and innovative solutions.

Globals is certified as a **"Great Place to Work"** organization for its laudable work culture that helps its team members manage work-life, have dedicated hours to upskill and reskill themselves, and most important to ensure that the projects that they are working on are always unique, challenging their status quo every time. Our unique work culture has made us one of the world’s fastest-growing technology companies as recognized and featured by **The Economist**.

Our excellence in technical stewardship and service-offering expertise has facilitated our clients ranging from individual entrepreneurs to Fortune Global 500 – to explore new business opportunities, reduce their operational costs significantly and boost their revenues. Today, Globals enjoys a strong position in the industry as a high-performing leader through its technology innovation and remarkable domain expertise. Globals is a **CMMI Level 5** certified company.

**About the Role:**

Globals is a defence-technology and cybersecurity company building secure systems across enterprise, space, drone, and AI domains. As a VAPT Engineer, you will lead vulnerability assessment and penetration testing engagements across networks, web and mobile applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure — probing systems the way an adversary would, and turning findings into clear, prioritised remediation guidance.

You will work hands-on across the full testing lifecycle: scoping, reconnaissance, exploitation, post-exploitation, and reporting. You will also help mature our AI-assisted testing capability — using and tuning tooling that accelerates scanning, triage, and remediation-suggestion generation — while ensuring every finding is validated by human judgement.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Plan and execute penetration tests across network, web, API, mobile, and cloud targets, from scoping through to retesting.
* Perform manual and automated vulnerability assessments; validate scanner output and eliminate false positives through hands-on verification.
* Research and reproduce vulnerabilities using OWASP, CVSS scoring, and current CVE intelligence to assess real-world impact.
* Develop and maintain Python automation and custom scripts to streamline recurring testing and reporting tasks.
* Operate industry tooling — Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, and equivalents — and apply AI/ML-assisted scanning to speed up triage.
* Write clear, evidence-backed vulnerability reports with reproduction steps, risk ratings, and actionable remediation guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support secure-development and compliance efforts in line with CERT-In Guidelines and MoD Cyber Security Policy where engagements require it.
* Partner with engineering and client teams to verify fixes and confirm closure of reported issues.

### **Requirements**

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

  

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in penetration testing / VAPT across network, web, and API targets.
* Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CVSS scoring, and CVE research.
* Proficiency with Burp Suite, Metasploit, and Nmap.
* Python scripting for automation of testing and reporting workflows.
* Demonstrated API security testing experience.
* Proven ability to write professional, client-ready vulnerability reports.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have:**

  

* Experience with AI/ML-assisted scanning tools (commercial or custom-built) and AI-generated remediation suggestions.
* Experience working with a CERT-In empanelled auditing organisation, with direct involvement in security assessment and audit delivery.
* Awareness of CERT-In Guidelines 2022 and MoD Cyber Security Policy 2020.
* Exploit-development awareness (understanding, not live weaponisation).
* CTF participation and/or a documented bug-bounty history.
* Relevant certifications — OSCP, CEH, GPEN, or eWPT.
* Prior exposure to defence, government, or space/drone security programmes.
* C/C++ in addition to Python.

**Priority Competencies:**

The strongest candidates will demonstrate depth across the areas below, weighted roughly in this order of importance to the role:

  

* Penetration testing — network, web, API: Critical
* OWASP / CVSS / CVE research: High
* AI/ML-assisted scanning: High
* Burp Suite / Metasploit / Nmap: High
* Python automation & scripting: High
* Vulnerability report writing: Medium
* API security testing: Medium
* CERT-In / MoD policy awareness: Medium
* AI remediation-suggestion generation: Medium
* Exploit-development awareness: Baseline
* CTF / bug-bounty experience: Bonus

### **Benefits**

**Why Globals:**

You'll work on security problems that matter — protecting systems across defence, space, and enterprise domains — as part of a small, high-ownership engineering team where your findings directly shape how products are built and hardened. We invest in offensive-security tooling, encourage research and continuous learning, and give engineers real autonomy over how they work.
